# Why your sleep gets worse in your forties
_Northwind Daily_

Sleep architecture changes with age: deep sleep shortens and night waking becomes more frequent.

Researchers point to shifting melatonin rhythms, caffeine sensitivity and late screen use as the main levers people can control.
